Welcome to Roanoke. @everyone 
Here's the quick guide to get you ready to go!

1st, read our <#731721743462563861> and <#731721723246018602>

2nd, our <#733776142829355013>  channel has helpful notes to learn ropes

3rd, go ahead and change your nick name to your character name and post your backstory and character picture in <#636014704854040577>

4th, change your discord profile picture to your character background for ease of play

5th, post what economic class you are in <#636014662609272863>
This has to go with our crafting guide system currently located in <#733776142829355013>

@everyone 
6th, go ahead and hop into one of our channels and begin role playing your character (for week 3) in the <#709304697713852446>

@everyone 
7th, you'll need to make sure to hop into <#714437511899906078> to register the name of your player shop/house that will be used for your weeks 3-5 (items are pinned). Your objective on the island is truly just to survive and find out what happened to those who came here before.

@everyone 
8th, your character's goal for week 3 is to simply **Survive**, explore the island, and find what secrets and mysteries befell the settlers who came here before you.

@everyone 
9th, there are some secret societies that hold knowledge and secrets of the new world that your character might be interested in. If so, your character may visit <#636016776349745164> for Order of Kairo, <#636016940489506837> for the Freemasons, or <#636017039126954024> for the Knights du Roi Soleil

@everyone 
10th, check out our announcements for events coming that day, or things affecting the world of our game!

11th, check out your player companion website here!
https://sites.google.com/u/0/s/13wtUEZh9-XlgGT7jEzGFqIXNqvGqKZIT/edit?authuser=0
